title: easywall web configuration
description: Configuration for the easywall-web daemon. See https://jp1337.github.io/easywall/configuration

bind_addr.description: Address and port for the HTTPS web interface.

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix socket of easywall-core. Must match socket_path in easywall.toml.

ssl_dir.description: Directory for TLS certificates. Auto-generated self-signed cert is stored here if no custom cert is configured.

data_dir.description: Writable directory for caches (e.g. version check). Defaults to /var/lib/easywall if empty.

language.description: Default UI language. Can be overridden per-session via Accept-Language header.

session_key.description: Secret key for signing session cookies. Must be at least 32 bytes (64 hex characters). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

username.description: Login username. Set via the first-run wizard — do not edit manually.

password.description: Argon2id password hash. Set via the first-run wizard — do not edit manually.

update_check.description: Check github.com once a day for a newer release and show a banner on the dashboard. This is the only outbound request easywall makes; set to false to remove it. The dashboard never waits for it either way.

demo_mode.description: Run against an in-memory mock instead of the core socket, for the public demo. No rule ever reaches a kernel and state resets when the process restarts. Never enable this on a host you are actually protecting.

tls.description: Custom TLS certificate settings. Leave both fields empty to use an auto-generated self-signed certificate; set both to use your own. Setting only one is rejected at startup.

cert.description: Path to a PEM-encoded TLS certificate file. Leave empty for auto-generated cert.

key.description: Path to a PEM-encoded TLS private key file. Leave empty for auto-generated key.
